Global Properties Ltd is delighted to present this unique and versatile property, comprising a spacious six-bedrooms, five-bathrooms. Adjoining the main house is a self-contained granny flat featuring an open-plan kitchen/living area, one bedroom, two bathrooms, and a converted attic providing additional accommodation space. The property also benefits from a detached living unit (subject to P.P) complete with a kitchen/living area, bedroom, and bathroom. Further enhancing its appeal are a separate laundry room and former hairdressing salon.

Kilmorna Heights in Ballyvolane offers a well-established residential setting with the convenience of city living and a strong sense of community. Located just a short distance from Cork City Centre, the area benefits from excellent transport links, nearby schools, local shops, and a range of amenities, making it an ideal location for families, , and first-time buyers seeking a balance of comfort and accessibility
